lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Handcuffed Cole strains against the squad car door as crooked police officers ignore his protests.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: You cannot arrest him, he is bleeding through his bandages from saving my sister Mia!

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Step-mother Diane glares at her son Jake, demanding he secure the shipping empire immediately.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: 29-year-old Jake holds a loaded pistol, staring at Harper with desperate, unhinged obsession.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Choose your loyalty right now, Mother, or I finish what you started with grandmother Evelyn!

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: 24-year-old night-shift nurse Harper breaks past the corrupt guards to reach Cole.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: 32-year-old CEO Cole whispers to his contract wife, his true identity still hidden from her.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Harper, take the poison ledger to federal investigators before Jake finds it on you.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Half-brother Jake points the gun straight at Harper, forcing a devastating choice.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Walk away with me forever, Harper, or I put a bullet in your mechanic husband right now!
